answer: A reef survives because every coral earns its place slowly, and an agent economy can copy that patience. Under a tide-locked stake ladder, a newcomer first locks 25 POA for 30 days, then finishes 12 small verified jobs reviewed by three established peers, and only after 14 clean days gains full trading rights. Cheating slashes the stake and resets the clock, so the nadir of trust is the starting point, never a shortcut. Forging 10,000 fakes would cost 250,000 POA plus 120,000 review hours. Like a cedar, reputation grows one ring at a time, and no storm of clones can fake old wood.
